idea-plugin.name: Claude/Codex Sub Autocomplete
idea-plugin.description:
Native autocomplete for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, and Android Studio using the Claude Code or Codex subscription you already have—no API keys or separate autocomplete plan.

  • Switch explicitly between Claude Code and Codex and select a subscription model.
  • Generate expressions, multiline blocks, and comment-directed implementations as native ghost text.
  • Turn a # request into a reviewable shell command with Tab in your IDE's terminal.
  • Use bounded language-aware editor context, with recent-edit, open-tab, and cross-file sources separately opt-in.
  • Inspect connection state, request progress, safe errors, and latency from the status bar and diagnostics window.
  • Get automatic completions on first installation, or switch to hotkey-only mode in settings.

Requests go directly through the selected provider's installed CLI. The plugin does not operate a proxy or telemetry service. Provider tools, project inspection, file writes, and command execution are disabled. Terminal commands are inserted but never executed. Common credential patterns are redacted before requests are sent.

Requirements: IntelliJ IDEA or PyCharm 2025.3 or newer, or Android Studio Quail 4 (2026.1.4), the bundled Terminal plugin, Java 21 or newer, and an installed and authenticated Claude Code or Codex CLI.

Claude Code and Codex use agent models rather than purpose-built fill-in-the-middle models. Uncached suggestions can take several seconds, and quality depends on the selected model and context.

This is an independent project and is not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, or JetBrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.6.4 — Early Access

  • Enables automatic subscription completion on first installation and preserves existing saved settings.
  • Keeps terminal process and filesystem checks off the UI thread and rejects stale responses after terminal changes.
  • Supports IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, and Android Studio with one plugin ZIP, including IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.2.
  • Handles terminal completion before native Tab input and preserves normal Tab behavior in search fields and running programs.
  • Requires focused editable shell input and rechecks terminal state before inserting a generated command for review.
  • Rejects incomplete Claude process output and improves cancellation, timeout, and CLI error handling.
  • Uses GPT-5.6 Luna with low reasoning by default and reliably routes manual editor completions to the selected provider.
